rows.en: Fuhahahahaha! Which one of you wants to die?!
I'll blow you to bits!
I'll crush you with my own hands!
I'll send the lot of you to the next world!
I'll put you out of your misery right now! Heheheheheheheh!
There you are!!
I'll kill you!!
I'll show you what I'm made of! Here I go!!
This is revenge for my dear Gol! I'll kill you!
Gol, take this! I'll offer you their head as a parting gift!!
rows.notes: Speaker offers the enemy's head to the dead Gol.

rows.en: For my men you cut down! Today I finally get my revenge!!
I'll make you taste the agony of my dead underlings!
Too slow! This one's for Gol!!
This one's for Ganan!!
Come on! Come on, Dragonar!!
Fuhehehe! Come at me, whelp!
I've been waiting for you, Dragonar!
You think you can block my sword with that?!
You in that big a hurry to die?!
Like a moth flying into the flame!
rows.notes: Idiom: summer bug flying into the fire.

rows.en: Annoying flies!
Playtime's over!!
Don't think you can run from me!
Cocky little punk! I'll finish you off first!!
Uoooooh!?
Next time we meet will be the day you die!!
You'll remember this!
Gwaaah! Clever trick!!
Gyaaaaah!! I won't lose! I won't lose, damn it!!
Gruuh...! Now things are getting interesting!!
Gehehe...! You must really want to die!
Just a little longer... Hold together, damn it!!
rows.notes: Pleading with his machine to hold out (inferred; heavy-damage line).

rows.en: I'm not dying until I've smashed you lot!
Nnnnngh!! I really, REALLY hate crude bastards like you!!
Uaaaaah!! Die!! Diiiiiie!!
Waah!! It's started up again!! Waaaaah!!
uncertain: Unclear what 'started again' refers to (possibly an ally going berserk or a repeated attack); kept impersonal 'it'.

rows.en: You brat! Look what you've done!!
Nnngh!! Me, beaten by the likes of Dragonar?!
Gruuh!! Just a bit more!! I was so close to getting Dragonar!!
Not bad for small fry!
Heh, acting like a big shot!
D-don't get cute with me!!
Why am I losing to small fry like that...?!
Heh, cheap trick!
Fuhahahaha!! Struggle, struggle away!!
Damn you, Dragonar! I'll lop off your head!!
Not bad for a kid! Eh?!
Hyahahahaha, now this is fun!
What?!
Damn it, cheeky little trick!
Wh-whoops!
Heh! You've got less bite than I thought!
Fuhahahaha! What's wrong, what's wroooong?!!
Hyahahahaha! What was that supposed to be?!
What's wrong, youngster? Finished already?!
Heh! D-Weapons, my foot!
You're too soft!
Whoa, there! Heheh...
Now it's getting fun!
Come on, hit me from wherever you like!
Fuhehe! It's that bio-whatsit thing!
uncertain: Context unclear: Gon Jem seems to mention a 'bio-something' system (possibly a Bio Sensor effect); rendered as a vague 'bio-whatsit'.

rows.en: Clever trick!!
Too soft!
That saved my hide!
Heh! I've got so much power, I'm getting a nosebleed
Hehehe... Don't get surprised yet!
Fuhehehehehehe... Feels good!
Don't get cute!
Well, what's the matter?!
Uh-oh! Looks like I got a bit carried away!
Gruuuuh...! I was so close...!!
Tch... You lucky bastard!
You're hiding 'cause you're scared of my Azure Dragon Sword, huh?!
Bet you'd like to be put out of your misery by now!
You're not getting away!
Leave the rest to me!
Guhehe... You just shut up and wipe off your sweat!
rows.notes: Support line to an ally; speaker telling the ally to sit back.

rows.en: I can handle this one by myself... Hehehehehe!
Nobody lays a finger on my dear boys!
Idiot! Dodge properly, will ya!
Think a little! Is your head just a stand for your helmet?!
Men!! Pound them to pieces!!
Let's go, you lot!!
That thing's nothing! Smash it!!
Leave it to me!
I'll deliver you straight to Hell!!
Behold! A stroke of vengeance!!
Where should I start slicing you up?!
Kieeeeeeeh!!
Take thiiis!
Whether you survive is up to your luck!
I'm getting fired up...!
Nobody can stop me now!!
Now that it's come to this, I'll go all the way!
You're not getting past here!
I won't go easy on anyone who gets in my way!!
I'll do it!
Dragonar is right here!!
Here you come...! Dragonar will take you on!!
It's Dragonar!! This is gonna hurt if it hits!!
It doesn't feel right, but a master never blames his tools!
rows.notes: Proverb (Kobo never chooses his brush); Kaine in an unfamiliar unit.

rows.en: Payback for everything! Take it, Dorchenov!!
Dorchenov! You're the one I'll never forgive!!
I'm seriously pissed off!! This is gonna hurt if it hits!!
I'm gonna land one on that smug jerk!!
rows.notes: The smug one (kiza) is presumably Meio.

rows.en: Let's settle this! Blue Hawk of Giganos!!
rows.notes: Also used by Kaine's other entry.

rows.en: I'll settle this right here...!! Here I go!!
There you are, saw-woman!
uncertain: 'Saw-woman' (nokogiri onna): insult aimed at Min, presumably for her weapon; literal rendering.

rows.en: Just you wait, you Giganos morons!!
Here I come, Giganos!
I'll keep fighting till I've smashed you Giganos creeps!!
Being big isn't everything!!
So the watchdogs showed up!!
So you showed up, Gon Jem, you creep!!
Here I come, little elite rich boys!
I'll beat that rotten pride out of you!
So you showed up, you Giganos morons!!
It's him! One of the Gon Jem Squad bastards!
I won't let you wreck the world for your own selfish whims!!
Your rampage... We're gonna stop it!!
What can you do with borrowed power?!
Making a fool of me!
You've done whatever you damn well please!!
After all this, you think I'll keep quiet?!
Now the real fight begins!
I won't let you get awaaay!!
I'll pay you back for that, with interest!
You startled me! Now watch this!
Mobility vs. mobility!
How can I be a hero if I'm scared of Gon Jem?!
You smug jerk!!
D-damn iiiit!!
Ugh! If I'm lucky, we'll meet again!
This is it for me! The rest is up to you!!
Oh God! Is this the end?!
Whoa whoa!! Wait, hold on a sec!!
Damn it! I'm not throwing my life away in a place like this!!
Gah! That bastard... I've had it now!!
He, heheh... Toughness is one thing I've got!
I-I've just gotta get through this somehow...!
Hang in there! Moooove!!
Heh! You can't be a soldier if you're scared to die!!
No way... A mass-produced unit built from Dragonar's best bits...!
Th-that bastard! Going wild with brute strength!!
Uwaah!! This guy's insane...!!
Dorchenov...! Don't get cocky!!
Haa, haa... I can't keep up with that one...!!
F-fine by me, rich boys!!
Ugh! At this rate, they'll beat me!
D-damn it! Isn't there anything I can do?!
Damn it, this guy's good...!
Ugh! Tapp, Light! I need cover!!
What is this thing?! I can't shake it off!
Wh-why you...! Getting full of yourself!!
Couldn't you go just a bit easier on me?!
No sweat! Now comes my big moment!
What's with this mass-production unit?! Did they skimp on armor?!
At this rate, that thing's mobility will beat me!
What brute strength!! Damn it...!!
Gwaah! You monster...!
What the hell?! You paper-lantern gorilla!
uncertain: 'Chouchin gorilla' (paper-lantern gorilla) insult; target not certain, probably Gon Jem. Literal rendering.

rows.en: So you're finally getting serious, Dorchenov!
Not bad, Mr. Blue Hawk of Giganos!
Nngh! Why you, old hag!!
rows.notes: Aimed at a woman (presumably Min); full strength kept.

rows.en: Ow...! That thing moves pretty well for something so huge!
rows.notes: Japanese line has a stray full-width space before the line break; not reproduced.

rows.en: You got me, you pampered brats!
Damn it... I got hit!
Ouch! Using cheap shots like that!
Quit messing with me!!
Heh, that's nothing!
Huh? That's all you've got?!
Oops... That's what happens when I let my guard down
H-how uncool...!
That hardly counts as a hit!
Heh, just what I'd expect from Dragonar's little brother!
Ugh, they're enjoying this...!
Dorchenov! That won't work on me!!
Heh, looks like even the Blue Hawk has faded, huh?!
That smug jerk, darting all over the place!
Heh, all bark and no bite, huh!
What a noisy bunch of pampered brats!
Don't you mess with me!
Yikes, that was scary~!
Just keep on going that way!
Ugh, that Metal Armor's fast...!!
And don't come back out!
How's that! Surprised ya!
All right, the sideshow's over!
Y-you idiot! That was dangerous!!
Heheh! Pure skill, pure skill!
Keep it up like that next time!
Go on, hurry back home!
And that wasn't luck, you know
Damn, at this rate, sooner or later...!
...You idiot
How about it? Are we starting to look like pros?!
Bring it on, you pampered brats!
...Why you!!
Are you trying to smash my shield?!
Uh-oh...!
I somehow pulled through
Serves you right!
Nyaaah!!
Dragonar is immortal!
Kindly see yourself out... there we go!
Whoa! The missiles are veering off!
Haha! This sure is handy!
Hehe~ This is what happens when I get serious!
That's pure skill too, pure skill!
Heh! Now, now, no need to rush!
rows.notes: Kaine putting on mock-archaic samurai speech.

rows.en: I can see it...! I can read it!!
Outta ammo?!
Damn it! I'm out of ammo!
Where'd it go?!
uncertain: Target of 'where did it go' not specified; used 'it' (the enemy unit).

rows.en: Where's it coming from?!
No good, I can't keep my distance!
I'll nail this one for you right now!!
Ta-da-daaan! The cavalry has arrived!
I'm coming in at express speed!!
Tapp, I'll handle the rest!!
We're a team! What do you think you can do alone?!
All right! Perfect timing!
Over here, Meio!!
My future little bro... Er, never mind
uncertain: Joke about becoming Meio's in-law via Linda; the Japanese says 'future shatei' (little brother/underling), rendered 'little bro'. Target (Meio) inferred.

rows.en: Light! Leave that one to me!
Not bad, rich boy!
Be careful! That one's tough!
I won't let them lay a finger on you!!
I won't let that happen!!
Eyes front, Tapp!
That's what you call teamwork!
Meio! Look out!!
I'm gonna save Linda's big brother, you hear!
Light! Your unit can't handle it!
You rich boys are hopeless!
All right, let's put some guts into it!
All riiight, time to let 'em have it!
All right, watch this!
Ahh, what burning friendship this is!
This is my one-hit-kill tactic!!
The finishing...! Bloooow!!
I'll cut you in half!!
Uoooooooooooh!!
I'll shoot you down!!
Hit, damn iiit!!
There!
Take this!
Goooooo!!
Eat thiiis!!
Special move! Dragonar Three-Piece Fillet!!
uncertain: Attack call 'Dragonar sanmai oroshi' (fish-filleting cut into three pieces); not in glossary, rendered literally.

rows.en: My special Photon Bazooka!
Photon Bazooka, charge complete!
I'm counting on you, Clara!
rows.notes: Clara is the D-1's computer; Kaine adds -chan.

rows.en: Tapp, Light, you ready?!
rows.notes: Shared with Tapp and Light (Triple Attack combo).
uncertain: Line names Tapp and Light; when used by Tapp or Light the address is off. Translated for Kaine.

rows.en: We're good to go too!
All right, let's go!!
Ora ora ora!!
Hey, let's use that trick!
OK! Leave it to me!
Got it!
All right, the dreaded...
rows.notes: Combo call part 1; trails into the next row. Shared with Tapp and Light.

rows.en: Triple...
rows.notes: Combo call part 2. Shared with Tapp and Light.

rows.en: Attaaack!!
rows.notes: Combo call part 3. Shared with Tapp and Light.

rows.en: Full barrage! Focus your fire!
OK! Just leave it to me!
Charge complete!
Photon Bazooka, ready to fire!
Fiiiiiiiire!!
Do it the way I say, OK!
rows.notes: Kaine and Meio combo; this line is Kaine's.

rows.en: Heh, very well...
All right, here we go!
Let's go, Meio!
To think I'd end up teaming up with you!
Today's Dragonar is gonna hurt like hell!!
Your luck has run out! Perish!!
rows.notes: Meio's line in the combo (inferred from the formal tone).

rows.en: Prepare yourseeelf!!
Sorry... everyone...!
rows.notes: Kaine fighting on the Giganos side (forced betrayal story).

rows.en: I don't want to shoot! Please, stay back!!
Please dodge it...!
So my betrayal looks real, huh...!
uncertain: Meaning inferred: the former allies are fighting him for real, so his defection is taken as genuine.

rows.en: Stay back... Please, don't come any closer!!
I can't let you pass here either...!
Take care of my mom for me......!
Damn it! I never thought it'd come to this...
You're the one hesitating! Come at me like you mean to shoot me down!!
Hang in there for now, Dragonar...!
uncertain: Addressee may be his own unit or the former Dragonar teammates; kept the vocative 'Dragonar'.

rows.en: That's right... Right now I'm Giganos...!
As expected...! Blue Hawk of Giganos!
Are you missing my vitals on purpose...?!
Stalling for time...?! Even if you do that, I......!
What's wrong...?! Come at me for real...!!
I can't go down here...!
I can't lose either... Sorry...!
Stop it, I don't need any support!
Found 'em, found 'em!
rows.notes: Gol speaks in a slurred rustic dialect; rendered with rough, simple English.

rows.en: I'll do it... Lemme do it!
Watch me! I'm gonna shoot 'em down for sure!
Just a bit more and you're all done for!!
Well then, here's a present fer ya!
Gweheheheheheh!!
It's the Gon Jem Squad! Give yerselves up nice 'n' quiet!
I'm gonna finish this quick and go eat!
Guhehehehe! Dragonar, yer done for!!
Ooh!? What's that over there? It's Dragonar! Guhehe!
Diiiiiie!!
Nngaaah!! I'm real mad now!!
I ain't gonna forgive ya, even if ya cry!!
This farce...! Huh? What's a farce?
rows.notes: Gol borrowing a phrase he doesn't understand.

rows.en: Nngah! I'm gonna eat ya up!
I'm gonna rip ya to pieces! Dragonar!!
M-my Gewai's stronger, I tell ya!!
Re-re-re-re-retreeeeat!!
N-next time I ain't gonna let ya off!!
Dammit! I'm gonna chop ya to bits!
I... I was wrong!
Th-they hit me again!!
My machine won't move right! I think it went outta whack!!
Nngaah!! C-Colonel!!
D-Dragonar! I ain't never gonna forgive ya!!
Hongyeeh! Fungyaah!
Nngah! Gettin' in my way again!!
Huh!? I don't like it!!
Dammit!! I ain't forgivin' ya!!
So pushy, so pushy!!
Nngaaaah!! Dragonaaaar!!
Huh!? Uh-oh!
Gehehehe! I feel great!
rows.notes: Probably the Spirit (genki) command; the glossary hit 'Genki Saotome' for this word does not apply here.

rows.en: That's nothin' to my Gewai!
Dammit, I'm gonna smash ya!!
Huh? This Dragonar ain't so tough
Nuhehehehe!
See, I can do it too if I try!
I did it! Ihihihi!
Ain't I great?!
Hmph! Nuooooh!
That don't work on me!
Gufufufufu... I'm so smart
Quit gettin' in my way!
Huh!? Did it jam?
Ch-ch-ch-cheater!
I'm gonna keep goin' till yer in pieces!
I won't... I won't lose either!
Colonel! Watch me!!
Can't be helped, I'll help ya!!
I'm stronger, I tell ya!!
Colonel! I'm comin'!!
Nngaah!! I'm gonna kill ya!!
Now yer done for!
Go to Hell!
This is the end!
Sleep in peace!
Can you keep up?! You dimwits!!
Heh, you're mine!
Now, scream nice and pretty for me
An electronic warfare unit oughta be a lot slicker!
uncertain: Meaning of 'smart' uncertain: could mean sleeker-looking or smarter-acting; likely a jab at Dragonar-3.

rows.en: How long can you keep dodging?! Dragonaaar!!
I won't let things go your way!!
Don't underestimate a custom unit's performance!
Just like you wanted, I'll blow you away!!
You've got guts, picking a fight with us Gon Jem Squad!!
Go to Hell along with Dragonar!!
What?! Uwaaaaaah!!
That's enough for today!!
Th-that's harsh...! Not cool!
Like I'd let you lot beat me!
Whoa! What's going on?!
Gwaah!! How dare you, my face...!
uncertain: Zin speaks in a formal first person here, unusual for him; the line may be shared with or meant for another pilot. Translated as is.

rows.en: Why don't you hold back a little?! Huh?!
Damn it... I won't forgive you, Dragonaaar!!
Like this is gonna take me down!!
You sure about this?! You'll regret it later!
Ugh, what a monster...!
rows.notes: Enemy unspecified; avoided a gendered word.

rows.en: I can't just slink away like this!
Tch, Dragonar!
Don't make me laugh!
Don't screw with me!
Like a lousy attack like that's gonna work!
Heh! That was a fluke for sure!
So that's all your D-Weapons can do?!
You guys got eyes in your heads or what?
Hurry up and hit me already!
Hahahaha! Ahahahahaha!!
What's wrong, what's wrong?!
Is that all?!
Whew~! Impressive!
Next time, use another weapon!
Heh, that won't work on me!!
Tch, watch your back next time!
Damn it! It won't reach?!
Inhuman...? Fine by me!!
You showed your true colors!
I'm right behind you, Colonel!!
What're you playing around for! I'll take it, OK?!
Can't be helped... I'll take the hit for you!!
Tch, why do I have to do this!
Colonel!! Look out!!
What's gotten into you? This isn't like you!
How about this!! Attack!!
Roger! Here I go!!
